newsitem.title: GERMANY: Global One sees early profit, no comment on Veba.
newsitem.headline: Global One sees early profit, no comment on Veba.

text.p: Global One, the telecommunications joint venture of Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp expects to break even earlier than expected, the company's chief executive said on Tuesday.
Viesturs Vucins told reporters in Munich he expected sales this year to total $1.2-$1.3 billion. That compares with "more than $800 million" for the period from February to December 1996.
"We want to be the number one telecommunications services provider," Vucins said.
He made no specific profit forecast and did not comment on 1996 earnings. Sources close to the company told Reuters recently that Global One's start-up losses in 1996 were higher than expected.
Global One concentrates on providing global communications services for multinational companies and has operations in more than 65 countries.
